method: Historical 2023-2025 recency-weighted standard and PPR points per game, regressed to position priors and adjusted for recent availability. This is a fallback research baseline, not a current-season projection feed.

rookiePrior.evidence: First appearance in the validation or holdout data is used as the historical rookie proxy; live use requires years of experience equal to zero.

classificationThresholds.basis: Bottom and top quartiles of out-of-time-selected, projection-tier-adjusted player scales.

distribution.mixture: point-mass-at-zero plus conditional-positive empirical residual quantile function
distribution.residualDefinition: actual weekly points minus pre-week projected points, conditional on actual points > 0
distribution.warning: These are weekly conditional residuals. Do not add them directly to season projections or confuse them with aggregated season residual quantiles.
distribution.zeroOutcomeMeaning: Observed zero fantasy points; it is not asserted to be an inactive-game probability.

instructions: Select the source/position/projection-strength cell using its frozen bounds.
Keep zeroOutcomeProbability as calibration metadata; do not copy it into a player distribution or treat it as injury/availability probability.
Combine conditional weekly draws across the player's season only after adding a separately calibrated role/availability process and any approved correlations.
Take season-total quantiles at the fixed grid and emit them as [{p,value}] with unit season-fantasy-points and conditionedOn active-role.
Set provenance.calibrationId to this artifactId and retain source snapshot identifiers.

methodology.leakageBoundary: Only rows strictly before a scored season fit that season's model. Outcomes never enter their own forecasts.
methodology.hierarchy: source + position + projection-strength bucket -> position bucket -> position -> league
methodology.projectionBuckets: Position-specific training tertiles, frozen before validation/holdout scoring.
methodology.scoring: Pinball loss, weighted interval score, empirical central-interval coverage, and trapezoidal quantile-loss CRPS approximation.

dataQuality.warning: Too few holdout weeks have credible outcomes for production promotion; metrics are research evidence only.

dataQuality.rookiePolicy: No unvalidated rookie multiplier is applied; rookies use the promoted position-volume baseline.
